conflicts.spec1: MCP Activity and Impulse System Tool Call Enforcement
conflicts.description: strictBackend=true could prevent bootstrap template loading if not handled correctly
conflicts.resolution: Implementation already handles this: `if (options.strictBackend && !BOOTSTRAP_TEMPLATES.has(id))` allows bootstrap templates even in strict mode
conflicts.recommendation: No action required - design already accounts for bootstrap templates in strict mode

complementaryRelationships.spec1: MCP Activity and Impulse System Tool Call Enforcement
complementaryRelationships.description: Strict backend enforcement coexists with embedded bootstrap loading
benefits: strictBackend=true enforces backend for non-bootstrap templates
Bootstrap templates still load from embedded source as cold-start fallback
Best of both worlds: production reliability + development convenience

strictBackend only blocks non-bootstrap templates when backend unavailable
Embedded loading ensures devbob can start even without MCP server
